about: A Lovejoin box's datum, Constr 0 [B a, B b] (a = G1's generator, b = 2G, compressed), spelled 252 ways, each with what the node reads it as: constr0_ab (that box), other (other data) or refused. Made by record-box-spellings.py, beside this, with cardano-cli 11.0.0.0, offline: hash-script-data on each, then build-raw with it inline and debug transaction view (one hash-script-data refuses, patched into such a transaction, the ledger's decoder refuses too). seedelf-core's box reader (parse_mix_datum, so PoolBox::from_row) and seedelf-data's is_mix_datum each read exactly the constr0_ab spellings as a box. Never edited by hand; recorded again, by hand, only for a deliberate change.
